testing_gaps.title: Add a list-valued argument comparison case
testing_gaps.suggested_fix: Add cases showing that object fields nested in a list compare independent of field order, while reversing list elements still reports a conflict.
testing_gaps.why_it_matters: Current tests cover argument-order independence, a single-level input-object field order, and differing scalar argument values. They do not exercise list values through the new synthetic argument object, where input-object field order remains insignificant but list element order must remain significant.
